card.name: Inside table cells and cross-references
card.fires_on: Opening parentheses, symbols and partial strings inside dense dosing tables, section cross-references such as (2.2) or (7.2), and number or unit fragments in lab-value tables.

modes.label: Opening parenthesis in tables
modes.description: An opening bracket or the first digit inside it, in table cells or section references.

modes.label: Partway through table words or symbols
modes.description: The middle of an abbreviation, symbol or drug name in threshold rows, such as ULN or a brand name.
